description: This file defines the EndpointDiscoveryMiddleware class used within the AWS SDK for PHP to handle endpoint discovery logic, including caching, endpoint resolution, and error handling during the middleware execution pipeline.

classes.name:
Aws
discover_endpoint
classes.description: Class implementing middleware for AWS SDK endpoint discovery, managing cache, endpoint resolution, and error handling.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to wrap a handler with endpoint discovery middleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the middleware with handler, client, args, and config.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main invocation method called during request processing to handle endpoint discovery and request modification.

methods.name: discoverEndpoint
methods.description: Performs endpoint discovery via API call and updates cache.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on credentials, command, and operation identifiers.

methods.name: getDiscoveryCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command to perform endpoint discovery based on operation and identifiers.

methods.name: getIdentifiers
methods.description: Extracts endpoint discovery identifiers from operation input shape.

methods.name: handleDiscoveryException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during endpoint discovery, throwing if required or reverting to original URI.

methods.name: handleInvalidEndpoint
methods.description: Handles invalid endpoint responses, updating cache and retrying discovery if needed.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the request URI and headers based on the resolved endpoint.

methods.name: parseEndpoint
methods.description: Parses a URI or endpoint string into host and path components.

methods.name: useOriginalUri
methods.description: Reverts request to the original URI if endpoint discovery fails or is not required.
